label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
Rohan, fair question da. Sneha, no, he gets to ask. He and Divya trusted me with 3 lakh of actual money, not LinkedIn “belief in the journey” points. He shouldn’t have to decode a cricket captain press conference to know what’s happening.

Straight answer: FixKaro is still a thing. Your investment is at risk, but it’s not gone. I can’t honestly tell you “haan all safe” because I don’t know that. I also don’t think we’re at sad-face practice yet.

What happened: the bridge round from the Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 Oct. Term sheet was basically ready, but the money didn’t come through. One partner said “we love the energy” and then didn’t reply for 11 days. Apparently energy is renewable but funding is not.

Without that round, we couldn’t keep spending at the same rate. So last Friday we let 6 of our 14 people go. Everyone got two months’ pay, and we’ve helped four get interviews already. Interviews, not jobs yet. Still working on it.

That was the worst day I’ve had, full stop. These are people who worked hard for this company, and the funding and business decisions were my responsibility. Not theirs. I can make jokes about my own situation, but there isn’t a funny version of that bit.

Where we stand now: after the cuts, we have about five months of runway. We have around 41k monthly users. The plumbers and electricians side is growing; AC servicing is bleeding money. So the plan is to shut AC servicing and focus on housing society tie-ups. Three societies in HSR have already signed pilots.

I genuinely think we have a real shot there. But three pilots are three pilots, not a victory parade. We need to prove that this works and brings in enough money. That’s what the next few months are about.

On your and Divya’s 3 lakh specifically: you came into the 2025 friends round on the same terms as everyone else. I can’t promise you’ll get it back, or tell you when. There is a real possibility of losing it if we can’t make this work. There’s also still a running business here, with users and a plan I believe is worth pursuing. Both things are true.

Let’s do a proper call this week, you, Divya and me. I’ll show you the numbers, what we’re spending, what we’re cutting and what we need from the society pilots. You shouldn’t have to provide dinner-table investor relations based on my vague posts. Sorry you were put in that position.

And group, I’m okay. Not having the greatest month, but okay. Eating Maggi at office at 11pm so regularly that security uncle now asks “masala or plain?” Amma has also asked if TCS is still hiring, so the family has activated its contingency plan.

Coming Saturday. No pitch deck, no “we’re crushing it”, just dosa and beer. Pranav is buying. That round I would like confirmed in writing.
